data.one_liner: Flutter wrapper for Channel Talk chat SDK
data.what_it_does: Provides a chat widget, event listeners, and push notification integration for Android, iOS, web, and macOS.
use_when: You want to integrate push notifications via Channel Talk
You prefer a single plugin for all platforms
avoid_when: You already use the official Channel Talk SDK directly
You need a fully supported, officially maintained package
weaknesses: Unofficial, may lag behind official SDK updates
data.setup_notes: Add AndroidManifest service entry, iOS Podfile entry for ChannelIOSDK, update info.plist permissions, and optionally configure firebase_messaging for push. No build_runner needed.
